# Fortex Appliance Repair

> Licensed (CA #50759) and insured appliance repair across Orange County, CA. Technicians come to the customer; there is no walk-in shop. Service visit is waived with any repair. 1-year warranty on OEM parts, 90 days on labor.

- Phone: (949) 478-0089
- Hours: Mon–Sat 9am–6pm
- Book online: https://www.fortexappliancerepair.com/book/

## Service areas

- [Irvine, CA](https://www.fortexappliancerepair.com/areas/irvine/)

- [Anaheim, CA](https://www.fortexappliancerepair.com/areas/anaheim/)
- [Santa Ana, CA](https://www.fortexappliancerepair.com/areas/santa-ana/)

- Also: Newport Beach, Costa Mesa, Tustin, Lake Forest, Fountain Valley, Orange, Garden Grove, Fullerton, Mission Viejo, Laguna Niguel
